## Interpretation Notes

- The current saved results support a mixed conclusion rather than a universal improvement claim.
- The empirical_background branch improves realism and some secondary signals, but not the main headline metrics across the board.
- This still makes the limitation a good research choice because it is concrete, code-level, and measurable.
